repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate computes an absolute difference (lines 4-7) before checking the condition, whereas the IR requires a signed difference ($t2 - $t1) without any folding. Evidence F2 shows the JoI emitted an action when the IR did not, implying the JoI condition evaluated true while the IR's signed condition was false (e.g., a temperature drop).
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute-value logic. The script now directly computes the signed difference and checks it against the threshold, matching the IR's arithmetic direction and condition.
